name: THE BOARDING HOUSE PARLOUR
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE ANTIMACASSARS
LOOK_AT: Lace, on every chair, four hundred miles from anywhere. Somebody carried these here on purpose.
Every chair has one, and every one is starched. Two women in a mining camp starch lace. I'd follow them into battle.
Somebody has darned one, so neatly I only found it by looking for a flaw. There's always one.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. This is the quietest room in the territory.
Nothing. Not even the chairs creak. They wouldn't dare.
Nothing. This room is quiet on purpose, and it works.

subjects.name: THE PIANO
LOOK_AT: An upright with its lid shut and a doily on top. It looks like a piano that is kept, not played.
Rosewood, polished. There is a hymnal on the stand and a vase on the lid, and neither has been moved to play it.
A tuner's card is tucked in the music rest. Not mine. Somebody out here was in the trade before me, and good at it.
LISTEN_TO: …It's *correct*. Somebody paid to have this done properly. I may need a moment.
In tune. I keep checking. It keeps being in tune.
Nothing out of place in it anywhere. I'd like to shake whoever did it by the hand.

overrides.USE: It doesn't need me. I've never been so glad to be unnecessary.

subjects.name: THE FIRE
LOOK_AT: A fire in a grate with a brass fender, and a coal scuttle that has been polished. The coal has not.
The fire irons hang in order of size. Somebody in this room runs a tight hearth.
The only fire in town that isn't also cooking something, drying something or melting something down.
LISTEN_TO: A good fire, ticking. It is the first one I've heard in this town that isn't complaining.
A log shifting and the flame deciding where to go next.
Coal settling, warm and unhurried, like a cat.

subjects.name: THE PORTRAIT OF A QUEEN
LOOK_AT: A queen, in an oval frame, looking down on the parlor as if she owned the boarding house. She may.
A print of a painting of a queen, framed, and dusted on top of the frame. That is real devotion.
She hangs straight. In Consolation that makes her the most upright thing for miles.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. She is not amused, and she is not going to say so twice.
Nothing. Her expression suggests silence is expected.
The wire behind the frame, ticking against its nail as the fire warms the wall.

subjects.name: THE RUG
LOOK_AT: A proper rug, red and blue, with a border. I have wiped my boots on the step three times, and I'm still afraid of it.
A border of flowers nobody in the territory has ever seen growing. It came a long way to be walked round.
There's a path worn round the edge of it. Everyone in this house walks round the rug.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. A rug this good swallows footsteps whole.
Nothing. Even my boots are behaving.
Nothing. I've walked round it too, now.

overrides.PICK_UP: I would sooner pick up a sleeping bear, and with more confidence.

subjects.name: THE STAIRS
LOOK_AT: Stairs to the rooms. Forty men up there at six dollars the week, and not one of them allowed in this parlor.
A sign at the bottom: GENTLEMEN WILL REMOVE THEIR BOOTS. A row of boots under it, all removed.
The banister is polished. Nobody leans on it, because the sign says nothing about leaning and nobody wants to find out.
LISTEN_TO: Boots overhead, being taken off carefully. The house has rules, and the rules have ears.
Somebody upstairs, snoring in a respectable way.
A door closing very gently. The whole house closes doors gently.

overrides.USE: Lodgers only, and boots off. I am neither, and I'm attached to my boots.

subjects.name: THE TEA THINGS
LOOK_AT: A china pot, cups and a sugar bowl with tongs. Tongs. In Consolation.
The cups are a set. Every one of them matches. I have not seen two things match in this town since I arrived.
A tea cosy on the pot, knitted, in the shape of a hen. I have never respected a hen so much.
LISTEN_TO: A spoon turning in a cup, and then stopping, because I am being looked at.
The pot ticking as it cools.
Nothing. The cups wait in their saucers like guests who know their place.

overrides.PICK_UP: Not without being asked. And I can tell already that I will not be asked.
